headline_marked: Over 1,000 migrants [[checked in Malaysia raid]], many detained
headline: Over 1,000 migrants checked in Malaysia raid, many detained
summary: Malaysian authorities conducted a massive operation to verify the documents of over a thousand migrants, leading to multiple detentions.
details: Malaysian authorities have carried out a large-scale 'comb operation' to verify the documentation of migrants. During the operation, the documents of more than 1,000 migrants were checked.
A significant number of migrants were detained during the raids, although the exact total number of detainees has not been specified.
These operations are part of ongoing efforts by the Malaysian government to regulate immigration and ensure all foreign workers are legally documented.
The raids targeted areas where migrant populations are concentrated, focusing on those without valid work permits or passports.
caption:
Over 1,000 migrants had their documents checked in a massive Malaysian raid. Many have been detained.

Malaysian authorities have carried out a large-scale 'comb operation' to verify the documentation of migrants. During the operation, the documents of more than 1,000 migrants were checked.

A significant number of migrants were detained during the raids, although the exact total number of detainees has not been specified.

These operations are part of ongoing efforts by the Malaysian government to regulate immigration and ensure all foreign workers are legally documented.

The raids targeted areas where migrant populations are concentrated, focusing on those without valid work permits or passports.

headline_marked: Expatriates [[send $1.15 billion]] to Bangladesh in first 11 days of July
headline: Expatriates send $1.15 billion to Bangladesh in first 11 days of July
summary: The surge in remittances during the early part of the month provides a significant boost to the country's foreign exchange reserves.
details: Bangladeshi expatriates have sent $1.15 billion in remittances to their home country during the first 11 days of July.
This influx of foreign currency is crucial for stabilizing the economy and strengthening the national foreign exchange reserves.
Remittances from overseas workers continue to be a primary source of foreign currency earnings for Bangladesh.
The government and central bank are monitoring these trends to ensure the efficient flow of legal channels for these funds.
caption:
$1.15 billion in just 11 days. Bangladeshi expatriates are fueling the economy with a massive surge in remittances.

Bangladeshi expatriates have sent $1.15 billion in remittances to their home country during the first 11 days of July.

This influx of foreign currency is crucial for stabilizing the economy and strengthening the national foreign exchange reserves.

Remittances from overseas workers continue to be a primary source of foreign currency earnings for Bangladesh.

The government and central bank are monitoring these trends to ensure the efficient flow of legal channels for these funds.
